title: Cursed Mode
description: Not for the Faint at Heart
§4§lTHIS IS NOT RECOMMENDED FOR A FIRST PLAYTHROUGH§r§r
You've found a ring with a strange, dark allure...
Energy courses through your body as it slips on your finger, rendering you sleepless evermore.
As you venture out, you realize — everything and everyone wants you dead. Every wound cuts twice as deep.
There's no telling what all this trinket has done to you.
Wearing the Cursed Ring adds special drops to the mobs:
Elder Guardian - Extra Prismarine Shards and Crystals, Guardian Heart, Heart of the Sea, Enchanted Golden Apple, Ender Eye, Trident
Zombified Piglin - Extra Gold Ingots, Glowstone Dust
Wither Skeleton - Blaze Powder, Ghast Tear, Netherite Scrap
